g.text: AFTERSHOCK / SYSTEMS RESEARCH
2. From a supplier failure to a reviewed payment consequence
Expected interactions. Agent reasoning is scripted locally; blue provider messages describe the future Sandbox integration.

g.text: Approval never guarantees stock or delivery. Capture is not settlement; pending is not completion; captured cancellations require refunds.
Research basis: completed Aftershock report, 19 October 2026. Not an official PayPal design.
